name: Pemoline

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in United States and 2 other countries, first in 1997 — for liver harm
Carries a boxed warning in United States

summary: Pemoline carries a boxed warning in the United States and was pulled from the market there and in two other countries starting in 1997 because of liver harm [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests in people, estimated a high liver score of 66 for this drug [M]. That same computer model calculated a low heart score of 15 [M].
